recipe.name: Jumbo Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipe.description: Jumbo cookie batch baked November 22. Quantities and 98 g portion size conflict; flagged for recipe review.
recipe.source: Bekah Baking 'Recipe And Pricing' conversation 2026-11-22; adapted from Butternut Bakery BEST Chocolate Chip Cookies

steps.instruction: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Melt 1/2 cup (112 g) unsalted butter and let cool. Whisk with 1/2 cup (100 g) packed brown sugar and 1/3 cup (75 g) cane sugar for approximately 1 minute.
Add 1 large egg and 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract. Whisk until combined.
Add 1/2 teaspoon baking soda, 1/2 teaspoon baking powder, and 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt; mix evenly.
Fold in 1 1/4 cups (165 g) all-purpose flour until combined, then fold in 1 1/2 cups (240 g) semisweet chocolate chips.
Portion dough into six jumbo balls reportedly approximately 98 g each; this yield-weight claim conflicts with the full-batch ingredient quantities and must be reviewed. Space apart on parchment.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 18 minutes, until edges are golden and centers remain slightly soft.
Cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes before transferring.

recipe.notes: One cookie was baked separately after the other cookies and looked different; a still-warm pan was discussed as a possible cause. Chilling was proposed but no mandatory chilling time was finalized. Extra chips and flaky salt were optional but no fixed amounts were specified.
recipe.changeReason: Newer six-cookie jumbo bake at 350°F/18 minutes vs older Butternut Bakery approximately ten 3-tablespoon cookies at 350°F/12-15 minutes.
